findings.title: Uniboost has no hookTypeId guard: an unwired/wrong dispatch hook silently accrues zero phUSD debt (M-04 fail-open class reborn on a third dispatcher)
findings.rationale: KEEP. New contract/function (Uniboost._dispatch via base ATokenDispatcherV2 unconditional hook.onDispatch); does not collide with M-04 fixed fp c91bef81 (ATokenDispatcherV2.constructor on NudgeRatchet line). Non-obvious Law-3 footgun: the owner who paid for the M-04 fix would expect the hookTypeId-guard parity on a new dispatcher, but Uniboost adopted only the decimal-awareness half. KI#4 does NOT suppress (non-obvious wiring footgun, not obvious misconfig). MANDATORY precedent carry: same fail-open class as owner-accepted wont-fix Q-08 (96c60b72, BalancerPoolerV2). Likely lands acknowledged/wont-fix at triage, but it extends the fail-open surface to the dispatcher MOST analogous to the M-04-fixed NudgeRatchet, so it is surfaced for the owner's EXPLICIT decision on the new dispatcher, NOT auto-suppressed. PROPOSE-ONLY: do not write the wont-fix status; finding-manager upserts as open, sanitizer proposes wont-fix-per-Q08 for owner triage.
findings.precedentNote: Q-08 (96c60b72, wont-fix) and Q-07 (227562b1, wont-fix literal-drift) are the related wont-fix family on other dispatchers.

findings.title: UniboostMintDebtHook.scale derived from the hook's own ctor primeToken_ with no on-chain tie to the dispatcher primeToken(); decimals mismatch mis-scales all debt
findings.rationale: KEEP. New finding, same FAMILY as open L-07 (ac91a046 cross-dispatcher price re-denomination) but distinct contract/function (hook constructor vs NFTMinterV2.replaceDispatcher), so a distinct fingerprint, not a dedup. Decimal MATH half is the cleared M-03 fix generalized (correct direction + d<=18 guard) and is explicitly NOT re-raised. This is purely the deploy-time / setDispatcher binding-provenance gap: two same-typed address args both silently valid. KI#4 does NOT suppress (non-obvious Law-3 footgun). Law-1 tail: over-scale direction would over-mint phUSD (unbacked), so recall-keep is mandatory even at Low. Remediation: one-line ctor assertion tying scale to the dispatcher's primeToken().
findings.precedentNote: Open ledger L-07 (ac91a046) is the same decimal-config family on a different surface; cross-reference at report time, do not merge fingerprints.

findings.title: setPool repoints _pairToken without re-validating stored custom _primeToPairPath (stale path can route swap to wrong token)
findings.rationale: KEEP as QA. Owner-driven and near the obvious line, but NOT suppressed under KI#1/KI#4: the setter silently violates its own advertised invariant (path end == pairToken) across setPool, which a non-malicious owner could be surprised by. Recoverable (rescueERC20 sweeps stranded dust) and loud (next pool() reverts/under-funds), no theft and no silent value leak, so QA severity is correct. Remediation: clear or re-assert _primeToPairPath inside _setPool when the pair token changes. Goes into the QA bundle.
